'''Magna-Lok''' was a technology company that produced [[Starship/Legends|starship]] components. It produced the [["Short Round" barrel]], the standard [[laser barrel]] on all [[TIE series/Legends|TIE Series]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]], The [[TIE/IN interceptor/Legends|TIE/IN interceptor]] also used Magna-Lok's [[Plasma/Legends|plasma]]-bottling process to stabilize its ion flow.
